facts.what: 盯着 Finlay 搁在桌上的手出神；脑内声音喝令她坐下，只有她听见
facts.anchor: ‘Sit down,’ a voice scalds me. He doesn’t flinch. It’s only me who hears it.

facts.what: 客厅改作工作间；鼠尾草冒烟，她自称还没弄清各种鼠尾草用途
facts.anchor: I’ve only recently discovered sage, and there are so many different types: clary, woodland, juniper, lavender.

facts.what: 直视她说「我知道你是谁，很高兴见到你，Cassie」；她营业只用 Nova
facts.anchor: ‘I know who you are. And it’s very nice to meet you, Cassie.’

facts.what: 接电话离场，说 Aye、明天再打、我正在处理点事
facts.anchor: ‘Aye. Aye, that’ll be fine. I’ll call you tomorrow. I need to go. I’m dealing with something.’

facts.what: 广告只用 Nova 名、无 Cassie Torrance；她删光私人社媒，把 Nova 当面具
facts.anchor: Absolutely zero mention of Cassie Torrance.

facts.what: 只接待过约十人，Finlay 是第一位男性客户
facts.anchor: I’ve probably only seen about ten people, if that.

facts.what: 提起两天前那个 Botox 女人，免费场让她哭着睡着
facts.anchor: This totally rude chick who’d visibly injected so much Botox into her forehead she could barely muster a frown despite being so mardy

facts.what: 声音命令她停；她怀疑自己不是有天赋而是疯了
facts.anchor: Or maybe I’m not gifted at all. Maybe I’m just truly mad.

relations: Cassie 化名 Nova 经营解读；Finlay 是客户；两人自称此前从未见过
